sources.label: Wikipedia, "HAT-P-32b"
sources.quote: HAT-P-32b is a planet orbiting the G-type or F-type star HAT-P-32, which is approximately 950 light years away from Earth.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around HAT-P-32. Its orbit and size follow Wang et al. 2019's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "HAT-P-32b"
sources.quote: HAT-P-32b was first recognized as a possible planet by the planet-searching HATNet Project in 2004, although difficulties in measuring its radial velocity prevented astronomers from verifying the planet until after three years of observation.
